title: Pool Friction
statusNote: Main menu, help and options work; a free-play game starts, the cue ball can be placed, aimed and shot, and the balls roll and collide.
notes: The game is in Spanish only. Main menu: Iniciar juego (start game), Opciones (options), Créditos (credits), Ayuda (help), Salir (quit). Start game offers Estilo libre (free play), Jugador VS. CPU (player against the computer) and Juego en red (network game).
A shot has three steps: place or aim with the direction keys, press 5 to accept, then hold 5 until the power indicator shows the strength you want and let go.

Juego en red (network game) works between two players in one room of the site (Menu > Multiplayer): one chooses Crear partida (create a game) and waits, the other Buscar partidas (look for games), then the host's name in the list and the left soft key (Unirse: join). The host breaks. To leave, open the pause menu and choose Salir de la partida.

multiplayer.menu: Iniciar juego > Juego en red > Crear partida / Buscar partidas
multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one chooses Crear partida, the other Buscar partidas, the host's name in the list and Unirse; the table appears on both screens and they take turns. Each player's shot (placing the cue ball, the cue, the rolling ball, whose turn is next) is shown to the other. When one leaves, the other reads "Juego terminado por el anfitrión o desconexión". The host plays as EKA2L1.

controls.source: The game's Ayuda (help) screens for aiming and power; the direction keys when placing the cue ball, OK acting like 5, and the soft keys were observed in play.

actions.up: Move the cue ball when placing it; move up in menus
actions.down: Move the cue ball when placing it; move down in menus
actions.left: Turn the aim left; move the cue ball when placing it
actions.right: Turn the aim right; move the cue ball when placing it
actions.5: Accept the position or angle; hold to set the power and shoot
actions.lsk: Pause menu; left option on a screen (Continuar, Siguiente)
actions.rsk: Pause menu; right option on a screen (Volver: back)
